title: Deploying RDMA for Large-Scale Inference and Training Workloads
abstract: arXiv:2610.12815v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: RDMA can reduce communication overhead in distributed machine learning systems, but realizing these benefits in production requires more than replacing TCP. Variable-size messages, concurrent connections, bursty incasts, and service failures introduce challenges that hardware offload alone cannot address. This paper reports our experience deploying ByteExpress, a software communication layer over hardware RDMA, in ByteDance's parameter-server-based inference and training systems. We present three lessons from the deployment: efficient RDMA requires buffer management across application and transport layers; scalable communication requires coordinated management of connections, receive capacity, and outstanding data; and service availability requires recovery above the transport layer. translated_title: 在大规模推理与训练工作负载中部署 RDMA
translated_abstract: RDMA 可以降低分布式机器学习系统中的通信开销，但在生产环境中实现这些收益并非简单地用 RDMA 替换 TCP。可变大小的消息、并发连接、突发性的 incast 以及服务故障，带来了仅靠硬件卸载无法解决的挑战。本文报告了我们在字节跳动基于参数服务器的推理与训练系统中部署 ByteExpress——一种构建在硬件 RDMA 之上的软件通信层——的实践经验。我们总结出部署中的三条经验教训：高效的 RDMA 需要跨应用层与传输层的缓冲区管理；可扩展的通信需要对连接、接收容量和在途数据进行协同管理；服务可用性需要在传输层之上实现故障恢复。ByteExpress 结合了 RDMA 感知的内存分配器、零拷贝传输、QP 多路复用、接收信用流控、软件发送窗口以及 RPC 辅助的恢复机制（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文总结了字节跳动在大规模推理与训练系统中部署基于 RDMA 的软件通信层 ByteExpress 的三条经验：高效 RDMA 需要跨应用与传输层的缓冲区管理、可扩展通信需要对连接与接收容量和在途数据的协同管理、服务可用性需要在传输层之上实现故障恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper shares three lessons from deploying ByteExpress, a software communication layer over hardware RDMA in ByteDance's large-scale inference and training systems: efficient RDMA requires buffer management across application and transport layers, scalable communication requires coordinated management of connections, receive capacity, and outstanding data, and service availability requires recovery above the transport layer.
